reviews.comment:
La YPF de Godoy Cruz que pertence al ACA debe ser por lejos la estación de servicios mas lenta de toda CABA.
Yo no se si es porque están acostumbrados a los socios del ACA que un poco mas y les piden que le hagan el service completo al auto, pero tardan una eternidad en cargar nafta. Deberia haber un par de surtidores express para los que solo cargamos nafta y listo.

(Translated by Google)
The YPF station in Godoy Cruz, which belongs to the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina), must be by far the slowest gas station in all of Buenos Aires.

I don't know if it's because they're used to ACA members practically demanding a full service, but they take forever to fill up. There should be a couple of express pumps for those of us who just need to fill up and be done with it.

reviews.comment:
Recién fui a cargar combustible y no me querían recibir cambio, me mandaron al banco (no tenes que venir a cargar combustible con cambio tenes que ir al banco!! porque??) pésimo trato!! Querian la autorización de Velázquez para recibir dinero en circulación por ley!! Dos playeros  discutiendo en ves de contar y listo!! Mala ganas hasta para cargar el combustible ni te saludan!! Es más fácil ser amable, tratar como te gustaría que te traten!!

(Translated by Google)
I just went to get gas and they wouldn't give me change. They told me to go to the bank (you shouldn't come to get gas with change, you have to go to the bank!! Why??) Terrible service!! They wanted Velázquez's authorization to accept cash, as required by law!! Two attendants arguing instead of just counting it and being done with it!! They were so unfriendly, they didn't even say hello when you were filling up your tank!! It's easier to be friendly, to treat others the way you'd like to be treated!!
